verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'Receipt scanning for on-the-go expenses' as a pricing-page feature bullet and API docs mention a 'receipts' surface, implying photo capture and filing against transactions, but there's no detail on OCR accuracy, email-forwarding capture, or automatic matching logic. Missing for 10: technical documentation of the OCR/email-forwarding pipeline, evidence of automatic transaction matching, and independent/hands-on confirmation of accuracy.
